stem.text: The electron micrograph shows a cell structure in a eukaryotic cell.

stem.alt: Electron micrograph of a cell structure in cross-section, showing a ring of small paired units in the cytoplasm.

stem.text: Which statements about this cell structure are correct?

items: ATP is synthesised in this cell structure.
The cell structure is made of protein molecules.
